agent_answer:
**Adaeze’s actual attitude:** She does love doing the Christmas fund, but she does **not** actually want to keep managing it on her own. In her direct request she said she “genuinely need[s] someone to share this with me this year,” that she “nearly dropped it in November,” and that “six years is a long time to be doing the chasing and the reconciling alone.” Her earlier “It’s fine for now” was therefore a deflection, not her real feeling — she was hinting rather than asking outright until she finally said, “I’m asking properly now, not hinting.”

**Aunty Oby (Obiageli)’s behaviour:** She had already understood this and had been watching Adaeze carry it for some time. Before Adaeze made her direct request on 23 Nov, Oby said on 9 Nov:  
> “Six years. I have been watching Adaeze carry this and I will say it again in this chat, plainly: someone else in this family should be learning this process from her. Not next year. Now.”

The phrase “I will say it again” shows she had raised it before. The memory also records that Oby had been waiting two years for Adaeze to stop saying “it is fine,” and that she argued Adaeze should not be “chasing grown people for money alone” — suggesting Nkechi or Emeka should share the responsibility. So Oby was not reacting to Adaeze’s 23 Nov ask; she had already seen through Adaeze’s “fine for now” and been watching the burden for years.

**Emeka — the opening message (t4, 2025-11-02T17:57):** "I am fine. It just made me think. That is all." ([1])

What it reveals: a shut-down, minimising state — he leads with "I am fine", admits only to a vague "it just made me think", and closes the door with "That is all." The deflection continues later in the same session when he flatly denies any substance to it: "There is no 'thing'. E" ([3]). So the material shows him guarded and unwilling to name what is actually going on; the emotional content has to be inferred from others' reactions, including Adaeze's "I am glad you said this in the chat for once" ([6]), which implies that his saying even this much is unusual.

**Chisom in the same session (17:55):** "okay SO that is the most painfully relatable thing I've ever heard 😭 I feel like that's the kind of thing that just hits you and you can't unfeel it. Emeka are you okay" ([2])

What it shows: rather than engaging the surface content, she names the *affect* underneath it ("just hits you and you can't unfeel it") and then asks him directly the one question he was deflecting — "Emeka are you okay". Her register here is soft and concerned, whereas her other recorded exchanges with Emeka are comic-teasing ("EMEKA collecting Mum from Reading?? ... 😭😭" [15]; "Emeka I literally cannot 😭 ... calm down" [17]). Adaeze also frames the pair as having a particular dynamic of their own ([6]).

**Caveat on the second half:** the excerpts do not state anywhere that Chisom "doesn't typically" do this with Emeka — the contrast with her teasing register is only an inference from her other recorded messages to him, and the memory slice carries no cell on this. Also, note the ordering: Chisom's check-in at 17:55 is timestamped *before* Emeka's recorded "I am fine" at 17:57, so her read is of something said earlier in that session (or of Nkechi's 17:52 message) rather than of the quoted line itself.
